nodes.label: Agent Behavior Evals (Golden Scenarios)
nodes.rationale: Assert behavioral properties (correct tool, no invented params, confirmation before side effect) rather than exact wording.

nodes.label: API/Domain Tests + Tool Contract Tests + Agent Behavior Evals
nodes.norm_label: api/domain tests + tool contract tests + agent behavior evals

nodes.label: Eval Layers Aligned with the Article
nodes.norm_label: eval layers aligned with the article

nodes.label: Machine-readable retry contract; suggestions stay natural language
nodes.norm_label: machine-readable retry contract; suggestions stay natural language

nodes.label: Limit the Blast Radius
nodes.rationale: Expose only tools needed for the current workflow and prefer read-only capabilities.

nodes.label: Prompt Injection as a Trust-Boundary Problem
nodes.norm_label: prompt injection as a trust-boundary problem

nodes.label: Untrusted Context
nodes.rationale: The agent is untrusted, and so is the context influencing it; context does not gain authority by entering the prompt.

nodes.label: Default READ Workflow (CANCELLATION, GOVERNANCE, REPORT, FULL explicit)
nodes.norm_label: default read workflow (cancellation, governance, report, full explicit)

nodes.label: Deterministic agent-facing outcomes: platform defines what happened
nodes.norm_label: deterministic agent-facing outcomes: platform defines what happened

nodes.label: Preserve Provenance
nodes.rationale: Context carries source_type, source_system, resource_id, trust_level for security analysis, auditing and source-specific policy.

nodes.label: Narrow credential scopes (V2 §4), distinct from tool visibility
nodes.norm_label: narrow credential scopes (v2 §4), distinct from tool visibility

nodes.label: Identity Config (credential TTL, default user scopes)
nodes.norm_label: identity config (credential ttl, default user scopes)

nodes.label: Identity Must Survive the Agent Boundary
nodes.norm_label: identity must survive the agent boundary
nodes.rationale: Each boundary reduces trust; tool access does not imply access to every resource behind the tool.

nodes.label: Cost Governance and Execution Budgets
nodes.rationale: Cost governance answers how expensive one successful execution may become; distinct from rate limiting.

nodes.label: Observability Across Three Layers (Technical, Agent, Business)
nodes.norm_label: observability across three layers (technical, agent, business)
nodes.rationale: Correlate technical telemetry, agent decisions and business outcomes across the full workflow.

nodes.label: Rate Limiting (user, session, tool, loop protection)
nodes.norm_label: rate limiting (user, session, tool, loop protection)
nodes.rationale: Rate limiting answers how frequently a caller may invoke the system.

nodes.label: Rate Limit and Budget Are Separate
nodes.norm_label: rate limit and budget are separate

nodes.label: Tool Descriptions Are Part of the Behavioral Contract
nodes.norm_label: tool descriptions are part of the behavioral contract

nodes.label: Least Privilege and Human Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Consequential actions require explicit confirmation, but confirmation never replaces authorization.

nodes.label: Idempotency and Side Effects
nodes.rationale: Agent runtimes retry after ambiguous failures, so state-changing tools must be idempotent (Idempotency-Key).

nodes.label: Explicit Long-Running Operations (job / status / result)
nodes.rationale: Async job states (PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED) prevent the agent guessing after timeouts.

nodes.label: Authorize at More Than One Boundary
nodes.norm_label: authorize at more than one boundary
nodes.rationale: Tool authorization and business/resource authorization are distinct checks.

nodes.label: Retries and Timeouts Need Deterministic Semantics
nodes.norm_label: retries and timeouts need deterministic semantics
nodes.rationale: Runtime must know if an operation is safe to retry; retries bounded by idempotency, max attempts and cost.

nodes.label: Version Tool Contracts Deliberately
nodes.rationale: Record tool/contract version in production traces and roll out behavioral changes deliberately.

nodes.label: Deterministic retry decision (V2 §7): is repeating last request safe
nodes.norm_label: deterministic retry decision (v2 §7): is repeating last request safe

nodes.label: Controlled Dictionaries and Taxonomies
nodes.rationale: Enterprise semantics resolve through governed catalogs the agent cannot modify without human review.

nodes.label: Keep Deterministic Values Off the LLM
nodes.norm_label: keep deterministic values off the llm
nodes.rationale: Send semantic intent (LAST_3_MONTHS) and let the backend own dates, catalogs, budgets and side effects.

nodes.label: enterprise-agent-api-banking MCP Server (SYNC, STREAMABLE, /api/mcp)
nodes.rationale: Server instructions restate that the backend is the business authority and provenance marks context as data, not policy.

nodes.label: Agent Boundary
nodes.rationale: Keep enterprise APIs domain-oriented and put a dedicated agent-facing layer in front of them instead of reshaping every API for LLMs.

nodes.label: Agent-Facing Interaction Layer
nodes.rationale: Exposes a small set of semantically clear operations (e.g. find_customer_orders) that orchestrate several domain APIs.

nodes.label: Designing Enterprise APIs for the Age of AI Agents (V2)
nodes.norm_label: designing enterprise apis for the age of ai agents (v2)

nodes.label: Strong Backend Validation
nodes.rationale: Business validation and authorization always happen server-side regardless of the tool schema.

nodes.label: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools, Resources, Prompts
nodes.norm_label: model context protocol (mcp) tools, resources, prompts
nodes.rationale: MCP standardizes capability exposure but does not provide memory, workflow state, retries or orchestration.

nodes.label: Deterministic Clients to Probabilistic Callers
nodes.rationale: Agents select tools, infer parameters, chain calls and retry, so agent-generated requests must be treated as untrusted input.

nodes.label: Small, Strict and Typed Tool Contracts
nodes.norm_label: small, strict and typed tool contracts
nodes.rationale: Focused tools with explicit schemas and descriptions reduce ambiguity during tool selection.

nodes.label: The Backend Remains the Business Authority
nodes.norm_label: the backend remains the business authority
nodes.rationale: The agent may interpret intent and request actions; deterministic systems decide what is valid, authorized, safe and executed.

nodes.label: Do Not Use the Model as the Security Boundary
nodes.norm_label: do not use the model as the security boundary
nodes.rationale: Deterministic controls (schema validation, authorization, business rules, confirmation) must hold even if context corrupts model reasoning.

nodes.label: Raw dates are a distinct semantic failure from unknown enum
nodes.norm_label: raw dates are a distinct semantic failure from unknown enum

nodes.label: Explicit Semantic States
nodes.rationale: Return runtime-interpretable states (CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED, RATE_LIMITED, BUDGET_EXCEEDED...) instead of generic HTTP failures.

nodes.label: Retry budget rationale: polling is not a retry; confirmation and idempotent replays stay allowed
nodes.norm_label: retry budget rationale: polling is not a retry; confirmation and idempotent replays stay allowed

nodes.norm_label: figure: delegated identity and authorization chain

nodes.norm_label: figure: untrusted agent context flowing through deterministic controls

nodes.label: BUDGET_EXCEEDED: operation exceeds execution or cost budget
nodes.norm_label: budget_exceeded: operation exceeds execution or cost budget

nodes.label: INVALID_DATE_RANGE: range not valid for this operation
nodes.norm_label: invalid_date_range: range not valid for this operation

nodes.label: OPERATION_REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION: consequential side effect requires confirmation
nodes.norm_label: operation_requires_confirmation: consequential side effect requires confirmation

nodes.label: RATE_LIMITED: caller exceeded an invocation limit
nodes.norm_label: rate_limited: caller exceeded an invocation limit

nodes.label: UNKNOWN_CATEGORY: concept not in controlled catalog
nodes.norm_label: unknown_category: concept not in controlled catalog

nodes.label: Technical observability (Latency, errors, retries, dependency health)
nodes.norm_label: technical observability (latency, errors, retries, dependency health)
